import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check if there are any recent errors
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --err --lines 5 --nostream")
err = stdout.read().decode()
print("=== Recent Errors ===")
print(err if err else "No recent errors!")
# Check health endpoint
print("\\n=== Testing Health Endpoint ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" http://localhost:3000/health || echo \"failed\"")
print("HTTP Status:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check for any database connection errors
print("\\n=== Looking for DB errors ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 20 --nostream | grep -i \"db\\|database\\|postgres\\|supabase\" | tail -5")
db_err = stdout.read().decode()
print(db_err if db_err else "No DB errors")
client.close()
